note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Same query, volumes and kiosk; A links only the literal words, B also links the related wording supplied for each word.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a two-volume project archive with different words and related wording; still exactly one changed fact (the matching mode).
